cases.prompt: A Literature workflow has an approved reader-owned proposition with origin paths. Record it `/using-slipbox`.
cases.expected_output: Routes to the Record an Evergreen candidate action, requires proposition, reason, origin kind and origin paths, and does not reinterpret the proposition. The caller uses the natural imperative action followed by `/using-slipbox`.

cases.prompt: A specialist has assembled a complete note draft. Publish the artifact `/using-slipbox`.
cases.expected_output: Routes to Publish an artifact, runs /write-checks before any write, and uses the CLI only for the transaction. The caller uses the natural imperative action followed by `/using-slipbox`.

cases.prompt: Record a link between two notes, then inspect source analysis `/using-slipbox`.
cases.expected_output: Routes to Record a link and Inspect source analysis; exact CLI flags are obtained from the relevant reference rather than repeated in each action. The caller uses the natural imperative action followed by `/using-slipbox`.
